resources.string:
1. Overview & Engine
Turbo Overlay Monitor is powered by the Phoenix Engine. It is a lightweight, high-performance on-screen monitoring tool designed for gaming and hardware performance tracking. It displays critical system statistics in a compact, floating overlay window.

2. 100% Privacy & Local Execution
This app operates entirely locally on your device. It does not use any internet APIs, external cloud servers, background tracking, or user accounts. All system metrics and commands are processed locally on your phone.

3. Shizuku Integration & Permissions
Tap the Info (i) icon on the dashboard to open the Shizuku Status & Permissions panel:
- Shizuku Service: Grants elevated hardware reading and performance boost capabilities.
- Battery Optimization Exemption: Keeps the overlay monitoring service active during intensive gaming.
- Overlay Permission: Permits drawing the floating overlay panel over other apps.
The (i) symbol dynamically changes color:
- Green: Shizuku service is connected and active.
- Blue: All required permissions are granted, but Shizuku is offline.
- Red: One or more permissions are missing.

4. How to Use the Floating Overlay Window
Tap 'START OVERLAY' to show the floating edge handle on your screen:
- Edge Handle: Drag to position anywhere along screen edges. Swipe out or tap the handle to expand the floating monitoring panel.
- CPU Tab (Chip Icon): View live CPU load percentage graph. Tap again to switch to the per-core frequencies grid (Cores 0-7 in MHz/GHz).
- Battery Tab (Battery Icon): View real-time battery temperature graph, Voltage (V), Current (mA), and Power draw (W).
- Network Tab (Speed Icon): View live Download/Upload speed, Ping Latency (ms), and Signal Strength (dBm).
- Performance Tab (Bolt Icon): Tap Boost for instant performance tweaks. Toggle PM Mode for 1-minute auto performance boost repetition.
- Hide Panel (Minimize Icon): Tap the minimize button or swipe towards the screen edge to collapse the dashboard back into the handle.

5. Game Launcher Feature
Add your favorite games and apps to the built-in Game Launcher by tapping (+):
- Select multiple apps at once and tap Done.
- Launching a game automatically starts the Overlay Service (if Shizuku is connected) and applies Instant Performance Boost.
- To remove any game or app from the Game Launcher, simply tap (+) to open 'Select Apps / Games' and uncheck (unselect) that app, then tap Done.

6. Protect Your Game Experience
Enable this feature from Settings to safeguard your phone against thermal throttling and extreme load. When active, if CPU usage stays above 90% continuously for 20 seconds during overlay monitoring, the Overlay Service automatically stops itself to allow the device to cool down.

7. Performance Boost & Reset
Performance controls request maximum hardware responsiveness from the system. Each time the Overlay Service starts, all auto-repeat boost options reset to OFF by default for safety.

8. Developer Contact
